response: Saved Views is available today for every customer, included at no extra cost in all paid plans. Managing complex projects often means rebuilding the same filters, sort orders, and groupings again and again. Saved Views removes that repetition: configure a list exactly the way you need it—filtered by assignee, sorted by due date, grouped by status—and save it for one-click access anytime. Each user can save up to 50 views, so team members, project leads, and stakeholders can each build a personal library tailored to their own workflow, from daily standups to quarterly planning. Views aren't limited to personal use, either. Any saved view can be shared with your team, giving everyone the same filtered perspective without asking someone to rebuild it from scratch. Shared views stay current as underlying data changes, so a shared "Overdue Tasks" or "This Sprint" view always reflects the true state of your project. Give it a try right now. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
